## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, resulting behavior, assigned existing task IDs, and scope.

## Full task specification

Paste the complete public task specification here, with its path and revision.
A link alone is insufficient. State the portion covered and any remaining scope.

## Actual changes

List changed boundaries, contract revisions, prerequisite PRs, and application steps.

## Visual evidence

Provide the actual interaction steps, expected and observed results, device/viewport,
and accessible before/after screenshots where relevant. Generated images and mockups
are not execution evidence. If captures are unavailable, explain why and keep the PR draft.

## Source, backend, and Expo revisions

- PR head/source SHA:
- Pinned upstream SHA:
- Backend deployed source SHA, or explicitly not started:
- Expo served source SHA, or explicitly not started:
- Safe development endpoint identifier:
- Browser/device/viewport and observation time:

## Verification and limitations

Record exact checks, API/state observations, failures, and unverified scope.
Distinguish Expo Web, native iPhone, Mac, synthetic tests, and product/provider tests.
Screenshots do not establish durability, fencing, or HA.

## Build and application scope

Record reload or incremental transformation used. Explain any full build.
Full image, desktop, and release builds do not run automatically on every PR.

## Team lead review

The team lead records review comments and the reviewed head SHA, requests corrections,
and decides acceptance and merge. Workers do not merge. With one GitHub account,
self-approval is unavailable; a review comment is not an independent approval.
